I work in finance with the community accounts and I noticed something. People's debts are just zeroing out. They're not filing disputes or appeals. They're just gone.
I work in finance with the community accounts and I noticed something. People's debts are just zeroing out. They're not filing disputes or appeals. They're just gone.
When a debtor dies, their account should freeze, but instead it's been clearing, like, immediately. I thought it was a glitch, but it's not. It's just happened too many times.

I wasn't authorized to see it. I only noticed because I handle reconciliations. When I told my boss, my access was revoked and security walked me out of the building. I just think something's going on.
